info.title: Space Works API
info.description:
Multi-tenant makerspace hardware loan system.

Public flow: browse inventory, search with `q`, page with `page`, sign in as a member, submit a borrow request, then track it by public token.

Admin flow: authenticate with JWT, manage makerspaces, inventory, staff, QR labels, bulk imports, request review, issue, and return.

Authentication: staff/admin endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer <access>`. Public browser endpoints can use `X-Publishable-Key` when public key hardening is enabled. Server API clients send `X-Client-Id`, `X-Timestamp`, `X-Nonce`, and `X-Signature`. Generate a unique, unpredictable `X-Nonce` for every request and sign the byte sequence `METHOD\nFULL_PATH\nTIMESTAMP\nNONCE\nBODY` with HMAC-SHA256. The nonce uses 1-128 characters from `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `.`, `_`, `~`, and `-`. A deployment may temporarily accept the legacy nonce-less signed format while `APICLIENT_REQUIRE_NONCE` is disabled.

post.description: Social sign-in with web or attested device delivery. A person MFA is mandatory for (any staff role) gets the MFA challenge shape instead of tokens and finishes at auth/mfa/verify (#62); members sign in directly. Device delivery returns `device_trust`; an app older than the platform minimum gets 426 native_app_update_required. Native Apple audiences bind to the approved iOS app ID on the attestation challenge (or existing grant). New device grants derive staff authority from active local memberships. Superadmin device creation returns device_superadmin_not_supported (403); existing grants remain usable. Attestation outages return attestation_unavailable (503); obtain a new nonce and challenge before retrying.

post.description: Register this device's push token for the selected makerspace. Pushes then carry payload v3 (#116): string `data` with `v`="3", `event_id`, `makerspace_id`, `feature`, `event`, optional `inbox_row_id` and `link` (all as in v2), plus `channel` (Android channel id, e.g. `sw_loans`) and an optional `category`: `sw.open` (Open), `sw.inbox` (Open, Mark seen) or `sw.inbox.snooze` (Open, Mark seen, Snooze). Mark seen calls `POST /notifications/inbox/{makerspace_id}/{inbox_row_id}/read`; Snooze calls `.../snooze`. Titles are at most 40 characters and bodies 120. Money and evidence notices carry no category; no push action approves, pays, refunds or hands anything over. iOS `thread-id` is the makerspace id (events: `<id>.events`). See docs/mobile/MOBILE-APP-PRD.md.

Options plus a SERVER-derived answer to "must the caller pick one?".

The console must not infer this from effective actions. A null-`assigned_role`
legacy membership is scope-exempt and cannot be expressed that way, and "holds
MANAGE_MACHINES" is not the same question as "is narrowed by machine scope" -- a role
holding MANAGE_MAKERSPACE holds both and is exempt. Deriving it here keeps one answer
on the server, the same reason the dashboard carries `scope_mode`.

jwtAuth.description: One account per person: a person's token reaches staff routes only where they hold a staff role (in every targeted makerspace), with staff MFA. Native member grants never carry staff authority; a native staff grant is fixed to one makerspace and its staff routes require a matching X-Makerspace-Id. Member APIs may omit the header. Personal notification inbox, preferences and announcements accept member sessions; broadcasts and the makerspace-wide feed need staff authority.
